title: Pawgger
tagline: FROM THE WHOPPER TO THE WORKSTATION
description: A Frogger parody starring Colby, an orange tabby explorer who has just finished a triple whopper at the Burger King and must cross Perring Parkway to reach the Micro Center. Rat boss Perring Parkway Pete is waiting in the traffic. Three switchable looks: retro 8-bit, Ghibli-style painterly, and toon.
goal: Hop Colby across every lane, fill the five Micro Center bays, and get out of Pete's way.
features: Three switchable styles: retro 8-bit, ghibli painterly, and toon (Colby and Pete from the character library), with G to cycle or ?style=retro|ghibli|toon in the URL
Burger King to Micro Center story: start in the Burger King lot, finish at the Micro Center home bays
Day, dusk and night levels with matching music and sky grading
Home bays: a computer mouse (200 points) and a graphics card (150 points) as bonuses, nerds cheer when a level clears
Pickups: tuna, sardine, gold, collar, a whopper and fries
Generated levels, checked by a validator so every level is fair
Autopilot bot: clears levels 1-10 on seeds 1-10
241 tests, zero dependencies, single-file build for offline play
tips: Pete patrols the median on later levels, so watch his sweep before you cross.
Press G to cycle between retro, ghibli and toon, or open the page with ?style=retro, ?style=ghibli or ?style=toon.
Run the autopilot (botplay) to watch one way through levels 1-10.
credits: Design, code, pixel art, painted art and music: the Pawgger swarm (see the swarm section)
Colby and Pete in the toon style are built from the character library
